data.exact_reserve_text: In the calendar year there was a prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $1.1m. (2014: $6.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were $121.265m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows net prior-year strengthening of approximately $7.95m (6.6% of opening claims), driven by adverse development in the 2013 underwriting year that outweighed favourable run-off in older years (2011-2012). The report separately notes a small prior-accident-year favourable development of $1.1m on a claims-incurred basis (net presentation). No specific named catastrophe events are cited in the reserve movement commentary.

Losses continue to develop both positively and negatively on these open balances.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the gross claims development triangle (Note 18) by comparing the latest estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2013 (excluding the two most recent UW years 2014-2015) and summing the changes. The report also contains a narrative net (claims-incurred) prior-year favourable development of $1.1m; that net figure differs from the triangle-derived gross movement. All source numbers in the accounts are presented in $'000; values here are converted to millions of the native currency (USD) by dividing by 1,000. No explicit gross "movement in prior year's provision" line was provided; triangle method was used as primary gross source.
